grammarFocus: have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比。
title: Mei's Busy Week: Work, Duties, and Time
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是关于一个叫Mei的办公室职员的一周工作安排。请仔细阅读，注意她必须做的事情和她能够做的事情。回答问题时，请根据短文内容选择或填写。所有题目均为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
passage:
Mei works in a small office in Shanghai. She is an office assistant. She starts work at 9 a.m. and finishes at 6 p.m. She has to answer the phone and write emails. She must be polite to all callers. She can speak English and Chinese, so she helps foreign visitors.

On Monday, Mei had a busy day. She had to prepare a report for her manager. She also had to book a meeting room. She could not take a lunch break because she had too much work. She must finish the report before 5 p.m. every Monday.

On Tuesday, Mei can work from home. She has to join an online meeting at 10 a.m. She must send her weekly plan to her team. She can start work early if she wants. She does not have to wear formal clothes at home.

On Wednesday, Mei went to a training session. She had to learn a new computer program. She could not use her old program after the training. She must practice the new program for two hours every day this week.

On Thursday, Mei will have a performance review with her manager. She has to talk about her work. She must prepare some examples of her good work. She can ask for help from her colleagues.

On Friday, Mei usually finishes work at 6 p.m. But this Friday, she has to stay until 7 p.m. because there is a team dinner. She must not be late for the dinner. She can leave early on Friday next week.

Mei likes her job. She says, "I have many duties, but I can manage my time well. I must plan my day carefully."

grammar.title: have to / must / can; 一般现在时与过去时对比
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们用have to和must表示“必须”做某事。have to更强调客观需要，must更强调主观认为必须。can表示“能够”做某事。一般现在时表示经常发生的事或现在的状态，一般过去时表示过去发生的事。例如：She has to answer the phone.（现在必须） She had to prepare a report.（过去必须）
grammar.example: She has to answer the phone and write emails. She had to prepare a report for her manager.

options: She must to wear a uniform.
questions.explanation: must后面直接跟动词原形，不加to，也不加ing。所以“She must wear a uniform.”是正确的。
questions.evidence: She must be polite to all callers.

options: Yesterday, she has to work late.
Yesterday, she had to work late.
Yesterday, she have to work late.
answers: Yesterday, she had to work late.
questions.explanation: Yesterday表示过去，所以用had to。has to和have to用于现在时。
questions.evidence: She had to prepare a report for her manager.

questions.explanation: can后面跟动词原形，不加s或ing。所以“She can speak English.”是正确的。
questions.evidence: She can speak English and Chinese.

options: On Monday, she has a busy day.
On Monday, she had a busy day.
On Monday, she have a busy day.
answers: On Monday, she had a busy day.
questions.explanation: 短文描述的是过去的事情（On Monday），所以用过去式had。
questions.evidence: On Monday, Mei had a busy day.
